title: A rate-limited crawler
description:
Write `crawl(start, get_links, limit=3)`, a coroutine that visits pages breadth-first:

- `get_links(url)` is an `async` function returning the list of URLs linked from a page (it stands in for downloading it).
- Begin at `start`. Visit every page reachable from it exactly once.
- At most `limit` calls to `get_links` may be running at the same moment: use an `asyncio.Semaphore(limit)`.
- Pages at the same distance from `start` are fetched together (all of one level with `asyncio.gather`, then the next level).
- If `get_links` raises for a page, that page counts as visited with no links.
- Return a dict from every visited URL to its distance from `start` (0 for `start`).
hints: `async with gate:` around the `await get_links(url)` lets at most `limit` calls through at a time; the rest wait at the semaphore.
Keep a `distance` dict as your "seen" set: add a link (with its depth) the moment you first see it, so it is fetched only once even if several pages link to it.
unitTests:
import asyncio

SITE = {
    "/": ["/a", "/b", "/c"],
    "/a": ["/a1", "/"],
    "/b": ["/b1", "/a"],
    "/c": ["/broken"],
    "/a1": [],
    "/b1": ["/deep"],
    "/deep": [],
}

@test("distances")
def _():
    async def get_links(url):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        if url == "/broken":
            raise ConnectionError("404")
        return SITE[url]
    result = asyncio.run(crawl("/", get_links))
    check_eq(result, {"/": 0, "/a": 1, "/b": 1, "/c": 1, "/a1": 2, "/b1": 2, "/broken": 2, "/deep": 3})

@test("each page once, never more than the limit at a time")
def _():
    calls = []
    running = 0
    peak = 0
    async def get_links(url):
        nonlocal running, peak
        calls.append(url)
        running += 1
        peak = max(peak, running)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
        running -= 1
        return [f"{url}/{i}" for i in range(4)] if url.count("/") < 3 else []
    result = asyncio.run(crawl("", get_links, limit=3))
    check_eq(len(calls), len(set(calls)))
    check_eq(len(result), 1 + 4 + 16 + 64)
    check(peak <= 3, f"{peak} calls ran at once")
    check(peak > 1, "the calls of one level should overlap")
